Person.reason: CUSTOMER represents bank customers, including individuals and organisations.

Account.reason: ACCOUNT represents accounts held at the bank.

Transaction.reason: Transfers and teller transactions represent money movements; statement entries are derived postings.

Device.reason: No device vertex or device attribute is present.

IPAddress.reason: An IP address is recorded as a protocol attribute, not as a vertex.

LoginEvent.reason: Protocol records may capture sign-ons, but the schema does not identify them specifically as login events.

Beneficiary.reason: BENEFICIARY represents a payee and has an edge to a customer where applicable.

Merchant.reason: No merchant vertex or merchant attribute is present.

InvestigationCase.reason: No investigation-case vertex or case attribute is present.

OWNS.reason: Customer-to-account ownership is represented by reverse edges from ACCOUNT to CUSTOMER.

INITIATED.reason: Transfers link to debit accounts; teller transactions need a debit-marker filter whose value is inferred.

PAYS_TO_ACCOUNT.reason: Transfers link to credited accounts; teller deposits need a credit-marker filter whose value is inferred.

PAYS.reason: Transfers link directly to their beneficiaries.

FROM_DEVICE.reason: No device vertex or transaction-to-device edge is present.

FROM_IP.reason: Protocol records contain IP addresses, but no transaction-to-protocol or transaction-to-IP link is present.

AT.reason: No merchant vertex or transaction-to-merchant edge is present.

HOLDS.reason: Cards link to their accounts; the reverse edge gives account-to-card direction.

LOGGED_IN.reason: Protocol records link through external users to customers and their accounts, but are not explicitly identified as sign-ons.

LOGIN_FROM_DEVICE.reason: No device vertex or login-to-device edge is present.

LOGIN_FROM_IP.reason: IP addresses are protocol attributes, not vertices connected to login records.

INVESTIGATED_IN.reason: No investigation-case vertex or account-to-case edge is present.

Transaction.amount.reason: Transfer debit or credit amounts and teller amounts record movement values.

Transaction.timestamp.reason: Date-time attributes are present, but their string format is not specified.

Transaction.channel.reason: No attribute explicitly identifies how a transaction was made.

Account.open_date.reason: An opening date is present as a string; its format is assumed.

Account.status.reason: Record and posting-restriction codes may indicate status but need lookup and interpretation.

Account.kyc_score.reason: This is a customer-level risk class, not a numeric account-level KYC score.

Person.anonymized_ssn_hash.reason: A legal identity hash is present, but it is not identified specifically as an SSN hash.

Person.kyc_verified_at.reason: The last review date is a date-only proxy for identity verification time; format is assumed.

Beneficiary.bank_identifier.reason: The beneficiary's sort code and BIC are bank identifiers.

Beneficiary.name_hash.reason: The beneficiary short-name hash is present.

IPAddress.anonymizer.reason: No proxy, VPN, or Tor indicator is present.

account_under_investigation.reason: A posting restriction may be a block signal, but does not establish that an account is under investigation.

Confirm the OPENING_DATE and LAST_KYC_REVIEW_DATE string formats.
CALC_RISK_CLASS is a customer-level class, not an account-level numeric KYC score.
